data: NVIDIA's net income for fiscal 2025 (the year ended January 26, 2025) was about $72.9 billion, while Apple's net income for fiscal 2025 (the year ended September 27, 2025) was about $112.0 billion. Apple's figure is therefore roughly 1.5 times NVIDIA's ($112.0B ÷ $72.9B ≈ 1.54). Note that the fiscal calendars differ: NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 ended in January 2025, so it largely reflects calendar 2024, whereas Apple's fiscal 2025 ran through late September 2025. NVIDIA's fiscal 2026, which ended in January 2026, would be a closer match in time to Apple's fiscal 2025, and on that basis NVIDIA's net income was substantially higher than in fiscal 2025. These figures come from my recollection of the companies' reported results rather than a live lookup, so please verify them against the 10-K filings before relying on them.
